segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, eczema, or fragrance allergies, report the powder is gentle with little to no irritation, burning, or redness, though a few dissenters find it still too mild to exfoliate effectively.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe reduced flaking and softer skin without dryness or stripping, with one noting it helped without dehydrating drier areas.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one who is also sensitive, report zero irritation and improvement in textured or drier patches.
segments.mature: One 42-year-old and one 50-year-old reviewer with sensitive, rosacea-prone skin report the powder addressed fine lines and clogged pores without irritation.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention brighter, more even-toned skin and reduced fine lines with regular use, though this is based on only a couple of accounts.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the product cleans without stripping or drying skin, but two critical reviewers report it did nothing more than soften skin without real exfoliation, and one suggests skipping cleanser first to avoid dryness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general sensitivity report no redness, stinging, or burning after use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say the product does not strip or dehydrate skin and even helped with random rashes; no reviewer reports barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, acne scarring, and more even skin tone with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report clearer skin and faster resolution of breakouts, including one whose cystic acne scarring lightened, though one reviewer only saw softened skin with no acne improvement mentioned.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer specifically discusses oil control or shine reduction.

aspects.libelle: Mixing into clumps or watery paste

extraits.texte: This product has saved my skin! My skin is hyper sensitive to EVERYTHING!!! I had a skin allergy test done and the doctor's response was "Whoa you are allergic to a lot"! I have tried so many products to try to exfoliate over the years and even those marked for sensitive skin were too rough. When my 42 year old akin decided that it would be getting lines AND pimples (NOT AWESOME!) I started looking for an exfoliant again. This is it forever!!! It is gentle on my skin, affordable, makes my skin so soft and cleared out some little clogged pores that I thought were with me for life! Seriously if you have sensitive skin try this!!!

I've noticed that in some of the negative reviews people talk about how the texture changes and they don't feel like the exfoliator lasts - so just to be clear for anyone who hasn't used a product like this, it's a chemical exfoliator NOT a manual exfoliator (like a scrub). The powder should dissolve in the small amount of water you add and then create a foam as you rub your hands together that you then apply to your face. I'm 50 with sensitive, dry skin and I have rosacea so finding something that is effective but that doesn't irritate my skin has been really hard to find. This stuff is miraculous! I use it 2 or 3 times a week, and apply it for about 5 minutes before rinsing off. It helps keep my complexion bright and my skin smooth. It does not smell great - think Gerber baby rice cereal scented, not pineapple (sadly) - but it's so effective and so affordable! Highly, highly recommend.

extraits.titre: Removed a bunch of dry/flaky skin in one use
extraits.texte: Let me start by saying i have dry skin which gets even worse in fall/winter months. During these months i have days where my face is so dry that it becomes flaky no matter how much moisturizer, face oil or other hydrating products i use. I decided to give this a shot and all the flakiness is gone after one single use. I will definitely be adding this into my skincare regimen. Also, i see a lot of comments about the smell, but mine does not smell bad at all. Smells like nothing.

I like it. My skin is dry and sensitive and I didnt have any issues with the product. The smell is pretty mild. I notice that it has helped with the random rashes I would get all over my face. It also lasts a while. I was worried that it would clump up inside once exposed to moisture but that was not the case. I just had it in the shower for accessibility. Would recommend. 10/10. I naturally have dark circles so I cannot say anything specific change. I am melanated too.

I have dry fungal acne skin and the first time i used this my skin felt NEW. Ive rebought this three times and when i dont use it for a couple days my skin craves that type of cleanse again. It brightens and smooths my face while evening skin tone, 10/10

I have combination skin that tends to be very sensitive to products I introduce to my routine, especially any type of exfoliators. This has become a staple in my routine, with zero irritation/reactions. It's significantly helped textured and drier areas of my face without leaving my skin feeling dehydrated. I incorporate it around twice a week and follow up with the rest of my routine.
Not exfoliating at all. Can't use without water and the smallest amount immediately turns it into a cream. It does soften skin but doesn't deliver the exfoliation I was looking for.
